name: io.github.iowarp/jarvis-mcp
title: CLIO Jarvis
description: Jarvis-CD MCP - Pipeline Management for High-Performance Computing with comprehensive workflow...

tools.name: update_pipeline
tools.description: Re-apply environment and configuration to every package in a pipeline.

tools.name: build_pipeline_env
tools.description: Rebuild a pipeline's env.yaml, capturing CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH and PATH.

tools.name: create_pipeline
tools.description: Create a new Jarvis-CD pipeline environment.

tools.name: load_pipeline
tools.description: Load an existing Jarvis-CD pipeline environment.

tools.name: get_pkg_config
tools.description: Retrieve the configuration of a specific package in a pipeline.

tools.name: append_pkg
tools.description: Append a package to a Jarvis-CD pipeline.

tools.name: configure_pkg
tools.description: Configure a package in a Jarvis-CD pipeline.

tools.name: unlink_pkg
tools.description: Unlink a package from a pipeline (preserve files).

tools.name: remove_pkg
tools.description: Remove a package entirely from a pipeline.

tools.name: run_pipeline
tools.description: Execute a Jarvis-CD pipeline end-to-end.

tools.name: destroy_pipeline
tools.description: Destroy a pipeline environment and clean up files.

tools.name: jm_create_config
tools.description: Initialize JarvisManager config directories.

tools.name: jm_load_config
tools.description: Load existing JarvisManager configuration.

tools.name: jm_save_config
tools.description: Save current JarvisManager configuration.

tools.name: jm_set_hostfile
tools.description: Set hostfile path for JarvisManager.

tools.name: jm_bootstrap_from
tools.description: Bootstrap Jarvis config from a machine template.

tools.name: jm_bootstrap_list
tools.description: List available bootstrap machine templates.

tools.name: jm_reset
tools.description: Reset JarvisManager (destroy all pipelines and data).

tools.name: jm_list_pipelines
tools.description: List all existing Jarvis pipelines.

tools.name: jm_cd
tools.description: Change current Jarvis pipeline context.

tools.name: jm_list_repos
tools.description: List all Jarvis repositories.

tools.name: jm_add_repo
tools.description: Add a repository to JarvisManager.

tools.name: jm_remove_repo
tools.description: Remove a repository from JarvisManager.

tools.name: jm_promote_repo
tools.description: Promote a repository in JarvisManager.

tools.name: jm_get_repo
tools.description: Get repository info from JarvisManager.

tools.name: jm_construct_pkg
tools.description: Construct a package skeleton in JarvisManager.

tools.name: jm_graph_show
tools.description: Print the current resource graph frames.

tools.name: jm_graph_build
tools.description: Build or rebuild the resource graph with a net sleep interval.

tools.name: jm_graph_modify
tools.description: Modify the resource graph using a net sleep interval.
